newsitem.title: UK: Mill demand remains slow on European cotton mart.
newsitem.headline: Mill demand remains slow on European cotton mart.

text.p: Despite the further advance of New York futures, and the consequent firmness of sellers' price ideas, mill demand for raw cotton remained decidedly slow on most European markets, traders said.
Some limited enquiry was forthcoming for the standard African and Central Asian styles, from markets including Italy and Germany.
But, with the exceptions of sporadic, gap-filling transactions, typically not exceeding a few hundred tonnes, business in raw cotton remained at a low ebb.
